en: Color view of a town center with a landscaped park and round modernist fountain in the foreground, older low-rise houses and a church spire to the left, and a tall socialist-era high‑rise hotel or apartment block to the right. Several 1970s–1980s Eastern European cars are parked along the street. The reverse has address lines and multilingual caption identifying the scene as the central park of Covasna.
